_about: Damage types on the board (build 52). What every hit is made of (hits), how each enemy takes your weapons and spells (rules), the new enemies, the power-ups that grant resistance or immunity, each boss's special traits, and the champions: bosses you only meet in a challenger's quest. Tags and stat ids are the ones in docs/DAMAGE.md (src/game/damage/damage.js). Every number here is a placeholder until playtesting.

hits._about: cause -> the damage tags of the hit it deals (and its narrow family, if it has one). A cause that isn't listed has no tags: no resistance changes it.

rules._about: How the old enemies take your weapons and spells: immune, resist or weak to tags. A weapon or spell whose every tag an enemy is immune to does nothing to it; resisted, it costs the weapon a use more; weak, it costs nothing.

traits._about: The words for each boss trait and champion ability. A boss's trait list is in bosses below; a champion's abilities are in champions. Champions' abilities (stormcall, frostbreath, venomspit, quake, swarm, phase, harden) are never given to the island bosses.

charger.name: Lance charge
charger.text: Charges more often, and for longer.

blink.name: Blink
blink.text: Vanishes and reappears a few squares from you.

summon.name: Summoner
summon.text: Calls its minions onto the board.

trail.name: Burning trail
trail.text: Leaves a hazard behind it as it slithers.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.text: Moves faster once it's badly hurt.

rally.name: Last rally
rally.text: Shrugs off the blow that would finish it, once.

devour.name: Devour
devour.text: Eats apples to get its breath back.

tide.name: Tidecall
tide.text: Splashes rings of frost around itself.

stormcall.name: Stormcall
stormcall.text: Calls lightning down near your head.

frostbreath.name: Frost breath
frostbreath.text: Breathes a line of frost ahead of it.

venomspit.name: Venom spit
venomspit.text: Spits acid at the squares in front of you.

quake.name: Quake
quake.text: Shakes rocks loose all over the board.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.text: Calls a swarm of its minions at once.

phase.name: Phase
phase.text: Turns to mist for a moment: you pass through, and nothing hurts it.

harden.name: Harden
harden.text: Turns to stone for a few seconds: no blow lands.

bosses._about: Island id -> the boss's special traits (with their numbers) and how it takes damage tags. The boss's spell shrugs (resist: fireball, frost) stay in the island's file.
